provenance: Files copied verbatim from the v1 repository (github.com/alexmazuka/ukrinform)
role: Immutable bootstrap inputs. Ukrinform weekly sitemaps for 2023 have expired from the live site (HTTP 302->404, verified 2026-07-10), so URL discovery for P0 and the 2023 part of P1 cannot be re-run from the live web. These v1 URL inventories are one of three preregistered discovery channels (see PREREGISTRATION.md section 5). They are inputs, not outputs: no v2 number is taken from their derived columns.
